verses.text: “Behold, my eye has seen all this. My ear has heard and understood it.
lines: “Behold, my eye has seen all this.
My ear has heard and understood it.

verses.text: What you know, I know also. I am not inferior to you.
lines: What you know, I know also.
I am not inferior to you.

verses.text: “Surely I would speak to the Almighty. I desire to reason with God.
lines: “Surely I would speak to the Almighty.
I desire to reason with God.

verses.text: But you are forgers of lies. You are all physicians of no value.
lines: But you are forgers of lies.
You are all physicians of no value.

verses.text: Oh that you would be completely silent! Then you would be wise.
lines: Oh that you would be completely silent!
Then you would be wise.

verses.text: Hear now my reasoning. Listen to the pleadings of my lips.
lines: Hear now my reasoning.
Listen to the pleadings of my lips.

verses.text: Will you speak unrighteously for God, and talk deceitfully for him?
lines: Will you speak unrighteously for God,
and talk deceitfully for him?

verses.text: Will you show partiality to him? Will you contend for God?
lines: Will you show partiality to him?
Will you contend for God?

verses.text: Is it good that he should search you out? Or as one deceives a man, will you deceive him?
lines: Is it good that he should search you out?
Or as one deceives a man, will you deceive him?

verses.text: He will surely reprove you if you secretly show partiality.
lines: He will surely reprove you
if you secretly show partiality.

verses.text: Shall not his majesty make you afraid, and his dread fall on you?
lines: Shall not his majesty make you afraid,
and his dread fall on you?

verses.text: Your memorable sayings are proverbs of ashes. Your defenses are defenses of clay.
lines: Your memorable sayings are proverbs of ashes.
Your defenses are defenses of clay.

verses.text: “Be silent! Leave me alone, that I may speak. Let come on me what will.
lines: “Be silent!
Leave me alone, that I may speak.
Let come on me what will.

verses.text: Why should I take my flesh in my teeth, and put my life in my hand?
lines: Why should I take my flesh in my teeth,
and put my life in my hand?

verses.text: Behold, he will kill me. I have no hope. Nevertheless, I will maintain my ways before him.
lines: Behold, he will kill me.
I have no hope.
Nevertheless, I will maintain my ways before him.

verses.text: This also will be my salvation, that a godless man will not come before him.
lines: This also will be my salvation,
that a godless man will not come before him.

verses.text: Listen carefully to my speech. Let my declaration be in your ears.
lines: Listen carefully to my speech.
Let my declaration be in your ears.

verses.text: See now, I have set my cause in order. I know that I am righteous.
lines: See now, I have set my cause in order.
I know that I am righteous.

verses.text: Who is he who will contend with me? For then would I hold my peace and give up the spirit.
lines: Who is he who will contend with me?
For then would I hold my peace and give up the spirit.

verses.text: “Only don’t do two things to me, then I will not hide myself from your face:
lines: “Only don’t do two things to me,
then I will not hide myself from your face:

verses.text: withdraw your hand far from me, and don’t let your terror make me afraid.
lines: withdraw your hand far from me,
and don’t let your terror make me afraid.

verses.text: Then call, and I will answer, or let me speak, and you answer me.
lines: Then call, and I will answer,
or let me speak, and you answer me.

verses.text: How many are my iniquities and sins? Make me know my disobedience and my sin.
lines: How many are my iniquities and sins?
Make me know my disobedience and my sin.

verses.text: Why do you hide your face, and consider me your enemy?
lines: Why do you hide your face,
and consider me your enemy?

verses.text: Will you harass a driven leaf? Will you pursue the dry stubble?
lines: Will you harass a driven leaf?
Will you pursue the dry stubble?

verses.text: For you write bitter things against me, and make me inherit the iniquities of my youth:
lines: For you write bitter things against me,
and make me inherit the iniquities of my youth:

verses.text: You also put my feet in the stocks, and mark all my paths. You set a bound to the soles of my feet,
lines: You also put my feet in the stocks,
and mark all my paths.
You set a bound to the soles of my feet,

verses.text: though I am decaying like a rotten thing, like a garment that is moth-eaten.
lines: though I am decaying like a rotten thing,
like a garment that is moth-eaten.
